channel.title: DbDo Walkthroughs
channel.description: Short simulated walks through DbDo, using the JobTrail job search database that ships with it. Each one is about three minutes, with something to try at the end.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 00 - Overview and Table of Contents
item.description: Simulated walkthroughs of DbDo, made with AI: two synthetic voices, one working and one answering as a screen reader. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-00-overview-and-table-of-contents

item.title: 01 - Installing DbDo
item.description: You have downloaded DbDo underscore setup dot e x e, running a Windows screen reader. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-01-installing-dbdo

item.title: 02 - Opening DbDo for the First Time
item.description: DbDo is installed and not yet opened, so it starts on the JobTrail sample. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-02-opening-dbdo-for-the-first-time

item.title: 03 - Adding a New Record
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-03-adding-a-new-record

item.title: 04 - Editing a Record
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table, on a job you have applied to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0d-04-editing-a-record

item.title: 05 - Find and Jump
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table, sorted by employer. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-05-find-and-jump

item.title: 06 - Order and Where Filter
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0f-06-order-and-where-filter

item.title: 07 - Select the Columns You Hear
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table, which shows the employer, the role and the status. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0g-07-select-the-columns-you-hear

item.title: 08 - Report, Save and Copy
item.description: JobTrail is open on the actions table, which is the log of everything you have done. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0h-08-report-save-and-copy

item.title: 09 - Look and Prime
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table, on the Example Widgets job. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0i-09-look-and-prime

item.title: 10 - Related Records
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table, on the Example Widgets job. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0j-10-related-records

item.title: 11 - Mark and Unmark
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0k-11-mark-and-unmark

item.title: 12 - Inspecting a Record
item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table, on the Example Widgets job. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0l-12-inspecting-a-record

item.title: 13 - Work Search Record for a Claim or Counselor
item.description: JobTrail is open on the actions table, the log of everything you have done. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0m-13-work-search-record-for-a-claim-or-counselor
